product_metadata.title: IRIS USA 40 Qt. Plastic Storage Container Bin with Secure Lid and Latching Buckles, 6 pack - Pearl, Durable Stackable Nestable Organizing Tote Tub Box Toy General Organization Medium
features: MADE IN USA QUALITY – IRIS USA’s large pearl plastic buckled lidded storage bin tote is a perfect storage organizer that can fit all your items safely with the anti-break, durable polypropylene material made in the USA

STYLISH AND DISCREET – The pearl design of our plastic storage bin tote with lid creates privacy. You as a user know exactly what is inside, but also hides it from other people. Also, even if you don’t have space to hide the plastic storage totes in garages, closets and cupboards, no worries. With the new design you can put it in the living room or bedroom, and it will still look stylish.

STACK THEM UP – The Large Plastic Storage Container Bin Tote has grooves on the lid and body to create a secure stacking experience. IRIS USA lid-body construction ensures stability to stack securely for easy moving, and save space in your house, apartment, and condo.
BUCKLE UP – The large storage buckles latches onto the durable plastic lid, separating the inside and outside. Any valuables are safe from dust and liquids when securely buckled.
PULL HANDLE – Built-in pull handle on bottom of the large plastic container makes it easy to pull the plastic box container bin from any high shelves. DIMENSIONS: 19.13" L x 15" W x 11.5" H
description: Life is messy and chaotic. Take control from what is closest to you. Take IRIS USA’s Proudly Made in USA Plastic Storage Bin Tote Organizer with Secure Lid and Buckles in your hands and organize your surroundings. The Pearl Design of our plastic storage bin tote with lid creates privacy. Plastic Storage Container Bin Tote has grooves on the lid and body to create a secure stacking experience. Plastic totes and lids are also nestable when not in use to save storage spaces. The storage buckles latches onto the durable plastic lid, separating the inside and outside. Pull handle, built-in into the container allows the user to reach up and pull the plastic storage box from high locations. Enjoy organizing by utilizing our 5, 12, 19, 27, 32, 40, 53, and 72 Quart plastic storage totes. From a simple organization of a cupboard, cleaning up the clutter in your rooms, sending your kid off to college, or moving into a new house, we got you covered with these selections. Let’s Organize and make life a little easier.
